title: Snowboard Bindings Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The snowboard binding's plastic base can break during use, posing a risk that snowboarders can fall and suffer a serious injury. Units: About 230 bindings.

title: Children's Toy Jewelry Recalled Due to Aspiration Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry could break, releasing small beads that pose an aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 144,500 sets.

title: Go-Karts Recalled for Repair Due to Loss of Control Hazard
summary: The throttle that controls the go-kart engine can fail and not return the vehicle to idle speed, posing a loss of control hazard to the driver. Units: About 3,200.

title: Big Lots Stores Inc. Recalls Tea Light Candles for Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled candles can burn with a high flame and melt the plastic holders. This poses a fire and a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 233,000 sets.

title: Infant Seats for Shopping Carts Recalled, Chalky Residue Could Cause Skin Irritation
summary: These seats can have a white chalky powder or residue on their surface. It is the UV Absorber that has separated from the seat due to a molding defect that affected some seats produced in one or more molding runs. This could cause skin irritation to children who come into contact with the residue. U

title: The Little Tikes Co. Recalls Animal-Shaped Flashlights Containing Lead Paint Sold at Target
summary: The light green paint on the dinosaur-shaped flashlight and the brown paint on the dog-shaped flashlight could contain excess levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 20,800.

title: CPSC, Inverness Medical Nutritionals Group Announce Recall of Iron Supplements
summary: The iron supplements are not in child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. Ingesting multiple iron supplements at once can cause serious injury or death to young children. Units: About 64,000.

title: Philips Consumer Electronics Recalls Plasma Flat Panel Televisions
summary: Arcing by capacitors inside the left and right side of the back cabinets of these TVs can pose a safety risk. Units: About 11,800.

title: Coca-Cola® ElectroPlasma Lamps Sold at Rite Aid Recalled for Burn Hazard
summary: There is a burn hazard caused by an electric arc between the metal bottle cap and a human contact point. An electric burn is possible if the distance between the metal cap and the contact point is sustained at about 1/8 inch away from the metal cap. Units: About 21,300.

title: Jordache Ltd. Recalls Youth Hooded Sweatshirt with Drawstring for Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 30,000.

title: Swing Sets Recalled for Repair Due to Risk of Top Beam Disconnecting
summary: The connection between the swing set's horizontal top beam and the vertical end support post can break, posing a risk of injury, if the user falls to the ground or is hit by the beam. Units: About 3,600.

title: Olympus Recalls Film Cameras for Overheating, Poses Burn Hazard
summary: A defect with the flash circuit in these cameras can cause it to smoke and overheat when the camera is turned on. This poses a possible burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.2 million (in the U.S.).

title: AquaPod 12-Gallon Aquariums Recalled Due to Shock Hazard
summary: These aquariums have three power cords, two for the aquarium lamps and one for the air pump. When only one of the two lamp cords is plugged in, the unplugged lamp cord can become energized, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.000.

title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles for Fire Hazard
summary: Certain 2005 Eiger model year ATVs were assembled with an improperly manufactured plastic fuel tank. The thin portion of these tanks could develop a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,900.

title: BRIO® Corp. Recalls Pull-Along Snail Toy Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snail toy is sold with a rattle containing a bell. The rattle can come apart, and the bell poses a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2.100.

title: Fire and Burn Hazards Prompt Nite Lite Recall
summary: An electrical short circuit in the nite lite can cause it to overheat and smolder or melt, which can burn consumers or result in a fire. Units: About 35.000.

title: CPSC, Nashbar Direct Announce Recall Bicycle Resistance Trainers for Repair
summary: The base of the trainer has a blocking mechanism that can break, causing the bicycle to disengage from the stand, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: Espresso Machines Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: The electrical connectors in the espresso machine can erode, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 28,000.

title: Fall Hazard Prompts Performance Inc. to Recall Bicycle Resistance Trainers for Repair
summary: The base of the trainer has a blocking mechanism that can break, causing the bicycle to disengage from the stand, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 10,200.

title: Child's Death Prompts Replacement Program of Magnetic Building Sets
summary: Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforation or blockage, which can be fatal. This product is unsuitable for young children. Units: About 3.8 million.

title: Children's Jewelry Sold at American Girl Stores Recalled for Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 180,000.

title: CPSC, Nautilus Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Bowflex Ultimate 2 Home Gyms
summary: One end of the leg extension cable can release from the guide pulley and swing around, potentially striking the user or a bystander. Units: About 17,000.

title: CPSC, Speedway SuperAmerica LLC Announce Recall of "Speedway" Cigarette Lighters
summary: The flame can flare up or the lighter can catch fire when ignited, posing risks of unexpected fires and burn injuries. Units: About 500,000.

title: Espresso Machines Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: The electrical connectors in the espresso machine can erode, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,600.

title: Toy Cars Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The hubcaps on the toy's plastic wheels can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,500.

title: Radio Control Toy Trucks Sold by QVC Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical circuits within the truck can overheat, causing the toy to overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 8,000.

title: Signals Catalogue Corp. Recalls Underground Neon Signs for Burn Hazard
summary: The AC adaptor used with these signs can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,200.

title: Pelican Power Brick Battery Charger Recalled for Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery charger's circuit board can overheat and cause its plastic cover to melt, which poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 231,000.

title: RadioShack Corp. Recalls Toy Pliers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The toy's sliding yellow knob can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 25,000.

title: Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Toy Jewelry Recalled for Lead Poisoning Hazard to Children
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning and adverse health effects to young children. Units: About 580,000.

title: Lead Poisoning Hazard Prompts Recall of Metal Charm Bracelets
summary: The recalled metal charm bracelets contain high levels of accessible lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: About 25,000.

title: Reebok Recalls Bracelet Linked to Child's Lead Poisoning Death
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead, posing a risk of lead poisoning and adverse health effects to young children. Units: About 300,000.

title: Rocking Chairs Sold at Wal-Mart Recalled for Fall Hazard
summary: Poor construction and over-curvature of the chair's runners can cause instability, imbalance, fracturing of the wood, and tip-over during use. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 643,000.

title: Valsi Corporation Recall of Generators with Plastic Fuel Tanks For Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tanks can crack and leak fuel, posing a risk of fires and burn injuries. Units: About 900.
